name: Codex
description: inference@1 agent provider codex over the Codex CLI app-server.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Where Codex's own commands may write.

approvalPolicy.title: Approvals
approvalPolicy.description: When Codex asks before running something. Requests go through valet's tool gate.

utilityModel.title: Utility model
utilityModel.description: Model for small side jobs such as naming sessions; may end in an effort (gpt-6-luna-low). Empty turns them off.

minRateLimitNoticePercent.title: Usage warning threshold (%)
minRateLimitNoticePercent.description: Only warn about approaching a limit at or above this share. Hitting a limit always shows.

reasoningSummary.title: Reasoning summary
reasoningSummary.description: How much of Codex's reasoning streams into the chat.

hideBuiltinTools.title: Hide built-in tools
hideBuiltinTools.description: Turn off Codex's own tools (shell, view_image, web search, ...) where Codex allows it, leaving valet's.

denyTools.title: Denied tools
denyTools.description: Tool names the gate always refuses, as Codex's hooks name them (Bash, apply_patch, mcp__srv__tool).

ignoreGlobalAgentsMd.title: Ignore CODEX_HOME's AGENTS.md
ignoreGlobalAgentsMd.description: Hide the global AGENTS.md / AGENTS.override.md from Codex (valet's persona replaces it). Needs bwrap. Applies when the app-server next starts.

loadProjectDocs.title: Let Codex load AGENTS.md
loadProjectDocs.description: Off by default: valet's persona already carries it, so Codex would send it twice.

developerInstructions.title: Developer instructions
developerInstructions.description: Static instructions for every thread, ahead of valet's persona. Part of the cached prefix.

idleCloseMs.title: Unload idle threads after (ms)
idleCloseMs.description: The next prompt resumes the thread. 0 keeps them loaded.

codexPath.title: Codex binary
codexPath.description: Unset: codex on PATH, then ~/.local/bin/codex. Applies when the app-server next starts.

env.title: App-server environment
env.description: Merged over valet's own, e.g. CODEX_HOME.

config.title: Codex config overrides
config.description: Sent with every thread as dotted keys or nested tables, e.g. { "model_provider": "my-proxy" }.

models.title: Model list
models.description: Replaces Codex's model/list. Rename or hide models on the Models page instead.
